rows.r3_why: At 05:45 he asked for the word for 'motivated'; she gave حافز/دافع (motivation) then متشجع at 06:27. Didn't-know, tier 0.

rows.why: He used شجاع (brave) for 'motivated'; Amal had just taught متشجع and recast it at once.
After متشجع the word takes la- not 3ashaan; Amal said لا and 'It takes لا'.
He was talking about yesterday with present مش; she recast it into the past with ما كنت.
